$comment: Canonical Hakka design tokens — single source of truth for COLORS across all platforms. Mirrored to RN (tokens.ts), iOS (Theme.swift), and Android (ViewHelpers.kt) by scripts/sync-design-tokens.mjs. Hex values are RRGGBB (no #). Identity: 'Wok Hei' — warm graphite ground, flame accent, jade/chili/turmeric semantics, heat-ramp timing (dns cold -> download hot). status/method/timing are single-valued (picked mid-luminance to survive both grounds); accent lives per-theme in dark/light. Spacing/radii/type stay per-platform (tuned to each layout) and are intentionally NOT unified here.
